paper.title: HyperBandit: Contextual Bandit with Hypernewtork for Time-Varying User Preferences in Streaming Recommendation

settings.name_in_paper: Bandit-based streaming recommendation with time-varying (periodic) user preferences
unmapped: bilinear reward r* = c_a^T Theta_p^* c_u with a time-period-dependent user preference matrix Theta_p^*; time period p (35 periods per week) is observed by the learner
item features partly observed and partly latent (to be learned)
rewards in {0,1}: r = r* + zero-mean noise
settings.definition_quote: r^*(u, a, p) := \bm c_a^\intercal \bm \Theta_p^* \bm{c}_u ... the generation process of the observed reward can be formalized as r (u, a, p) := r^* (u, a, p) + \eta ... a corresponding reward r (u, a_{I_t}) \in\{0,1\} is observed

bound.expression_latex: 2 C_{\bm x} \sqrt{2 L T \ln\left(1 + \frac{C_{\bm \Theta} C_{\mathcal{U}}^2 T}{2\lambda L \delta}\right)} + C_{\bm x} \sqrt{\frac{2}{\lambda}} \sum_{n \in [N] } E_n

symbols.L: dimension of latent item features l_a
symbols.C_x: max_a ||x_a(T) - x_a^*||_{Psi_{a,T}} (elliptic-norm estimation error of latent features)
symbols.C_Theta: max over updates n and periods p of ||Theta_p^(n)||_F^2
symbols.sum_E: sum_{n in [N]} E_n, accumulated hypernetwork error E_n = sum_i ||(Theta^(n)_{p} - Theta^*_{p}) c_u||_2

conditions: latent feature dimension l_a = L for all items

source.label: thm:hyperbandit:regret
source.quote: Assume that the dimension of the latent features is $l_{a} = L, \forall a \in \mathcal{A}.$ The sequence of the actions executed by HyperBandit enjoys the following regret upper bound: with probability at least $1 - \delta$, \mathrm{Reg}(T) \leq 2 C_{\bm x} \sqrt{2 L T \ln\left(1 + \frac{C_{\bm \Theta} C_{\mathcal{U}}^2 T}{2\lambda L \delta}\right)} + C_{\bm x} \sqrt{\frac{2}{\lambda}} \sum_{n \in [N] } E_n

results.notes: Bound depends on data-dependent quantities (C_x, hypernetwork error E_n) that are not controlled; regret is defined via true (expected) rewards against per-round best item. The paper informally argues (not as a formal statement) that with enough hypernetwork parameters, N = O(sqrt T) and tau >= rank, sum E_n = O~(sqrt T) giving O~(sqrt T) regret. Setting mapping (contextual, periodic preferences) is approximate. Theorem number not printed in source.
